Bhahū.g: tasmiṁ sāmaññasaṅkhāte ariyamagge bahū sambādhā maggādhigamāya paṭipannassa pubbabhāge bahū parissayāti dasseti.

Bhāhisī.g: 1 bhāsissasi pakāsessasi, imaṁ paṭipadaṁ bhāvento sabbadisāsu kittiyā pākaṭo bhavissasīti vuttaṁ hoti.
